thread:
marta: Heads upLanding late at LHR (00:30) with an 8h connection. What's everyones favorite low-effort place to stretch, charge, and grab a light bite at that hour? Also curious about luggage-storage options.
owen: There's a left-luggage desk in T2 arrivals that opens until ~02:00 sometimes. Not guaranteed though.
jamie: If you can get to T5 it's neater for overnight, more benches and the lounges are nicer. But transferring between terminals can add time.
marta: Is moving terminals with hand luggage and a backpack a faff at that hour? I don't want to miss the connecting flight.
owen: If both flights are within the same terminal youre golden. If not, add 45-60min buffer for shuttle + security re-clear.
jamie: Food-wise, look for the sandwich kiosks near gate 20 in T3they do salads and soups late. Or bring a packet of instant noodles and ask for hot water at a cafe.
airportbot: Note: Several outlets have USB-C only outlets now. Map: https://www.heathrow.com/chargingpoints
marta: Luggage storage seems risky if desk closes. Maybe better to gate-check the big bag with the airline and keep essentials on me.
owen: Agree. Also find a quieter corner by a wall and set an alarm on phone + smartwatch. Cleaning staff do the rounds but usually polite.
jamie: For power: short USB-C cable + 2-port battery is clutch. If you plan to nap on a chair, loop the cable through your carry-on and tuck it under your jacket.
marta: Anyone tried sleeping pods or airport hotels for a short overnight? Budget options recs?
owen: aerotel at T3 has rooms by the hour but book ahead. Minute Suites sometimes at US airports but rare at LHR.
jamie: If you want privacy, aerotel or pay-by-the-hour lounges. Otherwise, earplugs + fleece + hoodie works surprisingly well.
marta: Amazing. I'll pack earplugs and a small powerbank. If anyone wants to trade airplane tips or travel stickers, I'll bring extras for the office :stuck_out_tongue_winking_eye:
owen: Bring a scarf, it's a life-saver for impromptu blankets.
jamie: Safe travels! Ping if you want a checklist before you leave.
